description: List the chats, channels or rooms a bridge's bot can see (GET /v1/bridges/{id}/chats), to choose from for allowed in thalovant_update_bridge. Each row has id, title, kind, the Discord server (guild_id, guild_name), allowed (it already answers there), and selectable (false for an encrypted room it cannot read). manual_entry true means this chat app cannot list its chats: type the ids instead, matching targets.pattern from thalovant_list_chat_app_connectors. Telegram lists only chats that wrote to the bot in the last 24 hours, and only while the bridge is paused (409 bridge_running otherwise): pause it with thalovant_pause_bridge, send /start@<bot username> in the new group, list, choose with thalovant_update_bridge, then resume. Listing is rate-limited per bridge. It changes nothing, but because it asks the chat network on the bot's behalf it needs the hubs:write scope, a paid plan, and the hub's owner or a workspace manager (403 for a hubs:read token, 402 on a plan without chat apps); THALOVANT_MCP_READONLY leaves it out.
